assurance_note: CV-Library, Totaljobs and Reed remain the core publication gate. Indeed UK and JobServe are secondary enrichment sources: they contribute when healthy but do not individually block publication. All five underlying job boards are separate data sources, while Apify remains a shared ingestion dependency; a platform-wide Apify outage is a common-mode failure.
